from pathlib import Path
p=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792485222/attempts/83275b2e45034ad1868f4c57ede5090a/system/state/workspace/programs')
p.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = max(set(x for row in grid for x in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    marker = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != bg), None)
    horizontal = marker is not None
    if marker is None:
        marker = next((j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)}) == 1 and grid[0][j] != bg), None)
        if marker is None:
            return [row[:] for row in grid]
    if horizontal:
        color = next(x for row in grid for x in row if x != bg and x != grid[marker][0])
        pts = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == color]
        delta = 1 if marker < min(i for i, _ in pts) else -1
        edge = min(i for i, _ in pts) if delta == -1 else max(i for i, _ in pts)
        shift = (marker - edge - delta)  # signed displacement to adjacency
        out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
        out[marker] = grid[marker][:]
        for i, j in pts:
            out[i + shift][j] = color
        stripe = (min(i + shift for i, _ in pts) - 1) if delta == -1 else (max(i + shift for i, _ in pts) + 1)
        if 0 <= stripe < h:
            out[stripe] = [8] * w
        return out
    color = next(x for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] != bg and grid[i][j] != grid[0][marker])
    pts = [(i, j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if grid[i][j] == color]
    delta = 1 if marker < min(j for _, j in pts) else -1
    edge = min(j for _, j in pts) if delta == -1 else max(j for _, j in pts)
    shift = marker - edge - delta
    out = [[bg] * w for _ in range(h)]
    for i in range(h): out[i][marker] = grid[i][marker]
    for i, j in pts: out[i][j + shift] = color
    stripe = min(j + shift for _, j in pts) - 1 if delta == -1 else max(j + shift for _, j in pts) + 1
    if 0 <= stripe < w:
        for i in range(h): out[i][stripe] = 8
    return out
'''
f=p/'task-e9266c08.py'; f.write_text(code)

res=m.transform(demo)
